The failing test is `testByteToStringVariations` in the class `Base64Test`, which calls the static method `Base64.encodeBase64String(byte[])` with the byte array representation of "Hello World".

The failure is a comparison failure where the expected string is "SGVsbG8gV29ybGQ=" but the actual string is "SGVsbG8gV29ybGQ=\n". The difference is the trailing newline character at the end of the encoded Base64 string returned by `Base64.encodeBase64String`.

This indicates that the method `Base64.encodeBase64String(byte[])` is appending a newline character at the end of the encoded output, while the test expects no newline.

To understand the root cause, I will now check the implementation of `Base64.encodeBase64String(byte[])`, as this method generates the Base64 string from the byte array.
